info.name: Slotify API — Full Route Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for **Slotify** (Next.js 16 App Router). Covers every route: public pages, auth pages, booking flow, customer dashboard, organizer console, admin console, API endpoints and server actions.

## RBAC Matrix (enforced by `proxy.ts` + `lib/guards.ts`)
| Route group | Guest | Customer | Organizer | Admin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/`, `/home`, `/book/**`, `/appointments/**`, `/misc` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `/login`, `/signup`, `/verify-email`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password` | ✅ (logged-in users are redirected away) | ➡ redirect | ➡ redirect | ➡ redirect |
| `/dashboard`, `/dashboard/bookings`, `/dashboard/settings`, `/dashboard/profile`, `/dashboard/notifications`, `/schedule`, `/reports` | ➡ login | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `/dashboard/appointments/**`, `/dashboard/questions` | ➡ login | ➡ `/dashboard` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `/dashboard/admin/**` | ➡ login | ➡ `/dashboard` | ➡ `/dashboard` | ✅ |
| `/api/auth/session` | 401 | 200 | 200 | 200 |
| `/api/webhooks/stripe` | signature required | — | — | — |

## Auth Model
Slotify uses **cookie-session auth** (JWT in the `session` httpOnly cookie), not bearer tokens.
1. Run **Auth ▸ Sign In (JS extract `session` cookie)** — its test script saves the cookie into the `sessionCookie` collection variable.
2. Every subsequent folder sends the header `Cookie: session={{sessionCookie}}`.

## Server Actions (`/dashboard/**` +1 POST)
Page-level server actions (`lib/actions/*.ts`) are React Server Action RPC calls, not plain REST. For automation, either drive them through the UI (Playwright) or POST Next-Action protocol requests (requires the action id from the page's RSC payload + `Next-Action` header). The **Organizer ▸ Create Appointment (server action)** request shows the protocol shape; swap `{{nextActionId_createAppointment}}` per build.

## Seed Data
Run `npm run db:reset && npm run db:seed`, then use:
- Admin: `admin@slotify.test` / Organizer: `organizer@slotify.test` / Customer: `aarav@example.com` — password `Password123!`
- Fixed IDs: `appointmentId` `aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000001` (paid, has questions), `aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000005` (group capacity 10), `aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000002` (free), `bookingId` `bbbbbbbb-0000-4000-8000-000000000001`.

request.description: Reads the JWT session cookie. `401 {user:null}` when missing/expired; otherwise `{ user: { id, email, role } }`.
Landing page. `200` HTML means the server and edge proxy are up (check the `x-middleware-rewrite`/redirect behaviour here).

exec: // Postman captures Set-Cookie automatically; mirror it into the collection var for Cookie headers.
pm.test('sign-in returned a page or action result', () => pm.expect([200, 302, 303]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Form-POST fallback for sign-in. In the real app `signIn` runs as a server action from `app/(auth)/login/page.tsx` and sets the httpOnly `session` cookie (JWT, 7 days). For the cookie to be captured here, run this once via the Postman *Interceptor* or use the Next-Action protocol variant below.

Server-Action RPC for `lib/actions/auth.ts ▸ signIn`. Grab the action id from the login page's RSC payload (`self.__next_f` chunks) and store it as `{{nextActionId_signIn}}`. Response is an RSC stream; on success it sets the `session` cookie.
`signUp` creates the profile (status `pending`), then generates + emails an 8-digit OTP (Resend). Returns `{ success, message, email }`.
`verifyOTP(email, token)` — verifies the signup OTP and logs the user in (sets `session` cookie).
`resetPassword(email)` sends an 8-digit recovery code via `password_reset` OTP.
`completePasswordReset(email, otp, newPassword)` — verifies the OTP and bcrypt-updates the password.
`signOut()` clears the cookie (expired Set-Cookie) and redirects to `/login`. Triggered from Navbar/Sidebar.
Marketing landing page with hero, features, architecture sections. Server component; fetches a few published appointments for social proof.
Marketplace grid. Calls `getPublishedAppointments()` → all active appointments with organizer info. Seed shows 7 services (1 unpublished UX Audit Workshop is hidden).

`getAppointmentById(id)` — service overview with organizer card. Stepper is intentionally hidden here (overview page).
Seed: `aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000001` = Brand Strategy Consultation (paid $150, 3 questions).
Calendar step. Availability comes from the appointment's jsonb `availability` (e.g. Mon–Fri 10:00–18:00, Sunday off).

query.description: YYYY-MM-DD — slots are generated from availability + duration and decremented by existing bookings (capacity-aware)

request.description: Renders slots from `getAvailableSlots(appointmentId, date)`. Capacity example: Group Bootcamp (capacity 10) keeps a slot open until 10 overlapping bookings exist.
Intake form: core fields (name/email/phone) + dynamic questions from the appointment's jsonb `questions` (types: `text`, `textarea`, `phone`, `checkbox` with `options`, `isMandatory` flag).
Paid bookings land here with status `pending_payment` and a Stripe Checkout button (`createCheckoutSession`). Free bookings skip straight to confirmation.
Reads `getBookingDetails(bookingId)` — appointment + customer summary after a successful booking/payment.
Standalone informational page (public route group).
Role is derived **only from the session** (query-param role override was removed). Customers see My Bookings + upcoming sessions; organizers see stats + chart; admins see system overview.
As a customer: `getUserBookings(userId)` — upcoming/past tabs, cancel & delete actions (`cancelBooking`, `deleteBooking` — both assert booking access).
Booking history timeline via `getUserBookings`. Cancel uses the styled ConfirmDialog.

Profile + Preferences tabs for everyone; Business tab (businessName, websiteUrl, description, timezone, default duration) renders only for organizers/admins. Saves via `updateProfile` / `updateOrganizerSettings`.
`getNotifications(userId)` — last 20, newest first. Mark-as-read actions: `markAsRead(id)`, `markAllAsRead(userId)`.
Agenda/calendar across the signed-in user's bookings (organizer services + customer reservations).
Reporting workspace for organizers/admins (revenue + booking analytics).

query.description: wired to Topbar search — ilike title/description

request.description: `getOrganizerAppointments(organizerId, searchQuery)` — organizerId is forced from the session (client value ignored). Customers are redirected to `/dashboard` by the edge proxy.

`createAppointment(organizerId, data)` — SECURITY: the supplied organizerId is ignored; the row is always created for the session's user. Returns `{ success, appointmentId }`. Requires the build-specific Next-Action id.
Public-style detail inside the console (`getAppointmentById`).

item.name: Edit appointment (basic info / availability / capacity / questions tabs)

request.description: Loads `getAppointmentForEdit` (ownership-scoped). Tabs persist through `updateAppointment` (title, description, price, availability jsonb, maxCapacity, isActive…).

Add / Edit / Delete / toggle-mandatory. Table rows live in `booking_questions`; the form flow reads the jsonb copy. Writes via `createBookingQuestion`, `updateBookingQuestion`, `deleteBookingQuestion`, `upsertBookingQuestions` — all ownership-checked.
Per-day working hours (`schedules` table) + `updateAppointmentAvailability` mirrors it into the jsonb availability used by the slot engine.
Cross-appointment question builder. Organizer/admin only at the edge.

`getOrganizerBookings(organizerId, filters)` — confirm/decline pending requests (`updateBookingStatus` — organizer or admin only), export CSV (`exportBookingsToCSV` — exports only the caller's own data).

`getSystemStats()` — totals for users, organizers, appointments, bookings. Guarded twice: edge redirect + in-page `getSession()` role check. Seed shows 9 users / 4 organizers / 8 appointments / 16 bookings.
`getAllUsers()` with role/status actions: `updateUserRole(userId, role)`, `updateUserStatus(userId, status)` — both reject self-demotion/self-suspension.
`getAllOrganizers()`. Seed includes Rohit Verma (status `pending`) to exercise `approveOrganizer` → role=organizer+active and `disableOrganizer` → suspended.

Responses:
- `200` `{ "user": { "id": "…", "email": "…", "role": "organizer" } }`
- `401` `{ "user": null }` (no/expired cookie)
- `500` `{ "user": null }` (malformed token)

On `checkout.session.completed`: flips the booking to `confirmed` and stores `paymentId`. Signature is mandatory (`stripe.webhooks.constructEvent`) — without a valid `stripe-signature` header you get `400 { "error": "Webhook Error: …" }`. Test locally with `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/api/webhooks/stripe`.

exec: pm.test('redirected to login with next param', () => { pm.expect([302, 307]).to.include(pm.response.code); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('location') || '').to.include('/login?next=%2Fdashboard'); });
